_comment: Reference values for qe-scf-si (QE 7.4 conda-forge build hac89879_0, PBE, Si diamond 2-atom cell, ecutwfc=40 Ry / ecutrho=320 Ry, 4x4x4 shifted k-grid). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: QE 7.4 from conda-forge (channel carries no 7.3.1; 7.4 is the closest 7.x release), PSlibrary 1.0.0 Si.pbe-n-rrkjus_psl UPF, 1 MPI rank + OMP_NUM_THREADS=2. 5 oracle runs produced identical values (energy spread 0 at the 1e-8 Ry print resolution, 9 SCF iterations every run). Tolerance set to physical minimum resolution 1e-5 Ry. Double-source check: stdout '! total energy' vs XML <etot> (Ha -> Ry) must agree to 1e-6 Ry.
